Application Data.NAME: BrightLight Supplies Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: BrightLight Supplies Inc. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality lighting fixtures and supplies, operating from a well-maintained storefront in Springfield, IL. Our product range includes residential and commercial lighting solutions, decorative fixtures, and energy-efficient lighting options. We emphasize customer service and offer expert advice on lighting design to enhance both function and aesthetics. While we limit installation services to less than 10% of our total revenue, we ensure that all products comply with safety standards to mitigate liability risks. Our inventory is securely managed with rigorous controls, including regular cycle counts and a monitored alarm system.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 15, 2023, BrightLight Supplies Inc. experienced a theft of lighting inventory valued at $2,500. The incident was reported to the local authorities, and a claim was filed with the previous insurance carrier. The status of the claim is currently open, pending investigation and recovery efforts.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, UL Listed, Secured Storage with Key Lock
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured perimeter fencing with monitored access control and on-site security personnel during business hours.
